title: Mixed Event — STRAY BAD DOG — Episode5 Their Backs Turned

meta.Event Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD shows signs of growth, inspired by changes in Toya. One day, they'll be able to reach the heights of that legendary night. With that thought in his head, Akito learns of the man said to be the closest to surpassing RAD WEEKEND...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I just wasn't good enough. If only I sang a little better, you wouldn't have had to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm the one that's holding us back.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, that's not true.
Akito, you've...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It is true. I know better than anyone else...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Even then, it's no reason to mope around like this...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We always get back up after we're knocked down. It's just what we do.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We kept clawing our way back after every setback and finally made it this far.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I never thought that I'd be the one that needed cheering up, especially from you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We still need to think about what to do during practice tomorrow too. I need to call An and...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I do believe that you're a good team. You sing well and put on good performances.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But every single person that performed during RAD WEEKEND was a genius or even more than that. I'm sure you saw that too, no?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Your teammates are all more talented than you realize and they may even become first-rate performers in their own right in time.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But it's too hard for me to believe that you'll be up there with them when that time comes.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Let's go. We still got practice tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
The BAD DOGS, huh?
Do they really have what it takes?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: That new guy's pretty good and can sing, but he makes a bunch of little mistakes here and there...

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Their songs end up being pretty lame...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, we should get home soon. It's already getting dark...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, okay.
Sorry for keeping you like this. We've been at it since the morning, so I'm sure you're tired too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm okay. We didn't do as well as we hoped during that last event, so let's keep trying and make the next one better...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right.
We'll show them what we're really made of...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No...!
This isn't it at all...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I know that Toya is way more talented than I am. I know that better than anyone else...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (As his partner, I need to be able to sing as well as he can. We're gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND together...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (We went through the same thing then and I kept finding ways to get better...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You want to enter an event by yourself?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, this'll be separate from what we do as a team.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We'll keep practicing as a team like always, but I'll duck out when I have to go do a solo event.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Kohane's been doing the same thing, so I thought I could too...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I don't really mind. Doing solo events can also give you valuable experience.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But if we're not changing how much we practice as a team, when do you plan on doing solo practices?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: After team practices. I've already asked for fewer shifts at work, so I can practice at night.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really? Are you sure about that...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What do you mean? I can handle it. I should be doing at least this much anyways.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, I can help when you do solo practices too...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Having someone see how you're doing might...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, I'll do that on my own...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is what you heard yesterday bothering you that much?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This has nothing to do with that. I just need to start practicing even more is all...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What's going on here? Something feels really wrong!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I agree...
Did something happen to you two?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Last night, we ran into that Tono guy...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We did a battle and lost...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Like I said, we battled and lost.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We couldn't even come close to his level and...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Forget it. I just need to do something about this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I have to keep getting better, so please, I need some time alone...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I promise not to be a bother to any of you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*...
Fine, do whatever you like.
I won't stop you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: For now, I'm gonna head off...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
But...
An, are you sure about this?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, but what else was I supposed to say? I doubt anything I said would've stopped him...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I don't disagree with you there. Akito can be unbelievably stubborn when he's like this...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We'll just have to wait and see for now. As anxious and restless as he may be right now, he might calm down a little after a while...

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: Those other guys have been getting all the attention lately, but that's not gonna stop me... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line:
W-Why are you here?!
Vivid BAD SQUAD isn't supposed to be performing today...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Some stuff happened and it's just me today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, An told me that you went and apologized to her and Kohane, but you still haven't said anything to us...

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: I feel like I shouldn't say anything until I sort of get back on my feet...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*...
Just don't ever do that again, okay?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyways, there's something I need to do so...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's been a while since I last did a solo event...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I've been doing performances with Toya since we joined together, and then came the other two...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (All in order to surpass RAD WEEKEND...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm not stopping until I do...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, that should be enough for today!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, I need to get going.
I have to do an event later.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Another one today?
Didn't you just do one?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The more the merrier, right? I can get a ton of experience this way.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Seriously, are you okay?
Your legs wobbled just now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
You look really tired, Shinonome.
Are you sure you're okay?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This is bad. Akito's pushing himself too hard. He hasn't been resting at all, has he?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Excuse me.
I need to go...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, where are you going?!
Ugh... Kohane, we gotta go!
